authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Turner’s first *śarati branch explicitly gives Chiliss/Gowro šar- break. These Chiliss, Gowro and neighbouring Maiya broken-state responses continue that stem with ordinary l-participial endings and local vowel variation. They are distinguished from the second *śalati rot branch.
